# a23xq-dt2w-fix

A Magisk module that makes **double tap to wake** work on the **Samsung Galaxy A23 5G (SM-A236B, `a23xq`) with an LXS touch panel**, running [haky86's unofficial LineageOS 22.2](#links).

**[Download the module](https://github.com/Anezium/a23xq-dt2w-fix/releases/latest)**

This is a community workaround. It is not made or endorsed by haky86, and it has been tested on **one phone** only. See [What has not been tested](#what-has-not-been-tested).

## Does it apply to my phone?

Not every A23 5G has the same touch controller. The module **only supports LXS** (`lxs_ts`) and refuses to install otherwise.

```sh
adb shell ls /sys/module | grep -E 'lxs_ts|ovt_tcm'
```

- **`lxs_ts`:** this module is for you.
- **`ovt_tcm`:** it is not. See [OVT panels](#ovt-panels).

## Tested on

| | |
|---|---|
| Phone | SM-A236B with an LXS panel (`lxs_ts` on `spi0.2`) |
| ROM | `lineage-22.2-20260316-UNOFFICIAL-a23xq`, Android 15, `userdebug` |
| Kernel | `5.4.281-g920d1d7c7904` |
| Stock firmware in the build fingerprint | `A236BXXSDEZA1` |
| Magisk | [v31.1](https://github.com/topjohnwu/Magisk/releases/tag/v31.1) |

## Install

You need Magisk first. [This guide](https://github.com/Anezium/a23xq-hotspot-fix#rooting-this-rom-with-magisk) shows how I installed it on this ROM.

1. Download the zip from the [latest release](https://github.com/Anezium/a23xq-dt2w-fix/releases/latest).
2. In the Magisk app, open **Modules**, then **Install from storage**, and select the zip.
3. Reboot.
4. Turn the screen off, then double tap it.

**To remove it:** disable or remove the module in **Modules**, then reboot. If touch misbehaves, do this first.

## What was wrong

The hardware and the driver both work. The driver is simply never told about screen changes in a format it understands.

`lxs_ts` expects `state,event` pairs on `/sys/class/sec/tsp/enabled`:

| Value | Meaning | Driver action |
|---|---|---|
| `1,0` then `1,1` | Screen turning off, early then late | `lxs_ts_suspend`, enters low-power double-tap mode if enabled |
| `2,0` then `2,1` | Screen turning on, early then late | `lxs_ts_resume` |

On this ROM, the node receives a single value instead, and the driver rejects it:

```
lxs_ts spi0.2: [sec_input] enabled_store: failed read params [1]
```

So `lxs_ts_suspend` never runs and the chip never enters double-tap mode. I did not identify what writes that single value. The power HAL binary contains `aot_enable` and `/sys/class/sec/tsp/cmd`, but not this path.

**Timing matters.** The chip must be told before the panel loses power:

| Sequence sent | Result |
|---|---|
| Panel still on | `lxs_ts_suspend: lpwg mode(0x20)`, no error, and double tap works |
| Panel already off | `ic test cmp err, 5A5A5A5Ah, 00000000h`, then `SW89112 lpm failed, -14` |

A side effect of the same bug: without this module, `lxs_ts_resume` is never called either. Touch only comes back through an emergency reset (`need reset`) with a firmware reload at each wake. With the module, the normal resume path runs, and no `need reset` appeared in my tests.

## How the module works

`service.sh` waits on Android's event log, with no polling loop:

| Event | Action |
|---|---|
| `power_sleep_requested` | Sends `1,0` then `1,1` |
| `screen_toggled: 1` | Sends `2,0`, waits 0.3 s, sends `2,1`, then re-applies the setting below |

- **Why this event:** it fires about 500 ms before the panel starts turning off, which leaves time to reach the chip. A real sequence from the logs:

  ```
  2131.022  enabled_store: 1 0
  2131.028  enabled_store: 1 1
  2131.048  lxs_ts_suspend: lpwg mode(0x20)
  2131.501  ss_panel_off_pre
  2131.676  panel power off
  ```

- **Why the 0.3 s wait:** resuming while the panel was still powering up made the chip's init fail and retry (14 errors over 10 wakes). With the wait: none over 6 wakes.
- **A cancelled sleep:** if the screen stays on after a sleep request, no `screen_toggled` event follows, which would leave touch dead. A check 2 seconds later resumes touch if the backlight is still on. This path was not triggered in my tests.
- **The setting:** the module sends `aot_enable,1` or `aot_enable,0` to `/sys/class/sec/tsp/cmd`, following `double_tap_to_wake` in Android's settings.

## Test results

| Test | Result |
|---|---|
| By hand with the module's script, including one sleep from the screen timeout | **7 sleeps and wakes out of 7:** 6 woken by double tap, 1 by the power button |
| Scripted sleep and wake cycles, final version | **6 out of 6** with no `lpm failed`, `init failed` or `need reset` |
| Scripted cycles after a reboot, module started by Magisk | **3 out of 3**, same counters |
| Release zip | Installed through `magisk --install-module`; the resulting script is byte-identical to the one tested |

The hand test ran the same script from memory. After the reboot, only the scripted cycles were run, without a finger on the screen.

## What has not been tested

- **Battery:** the chip keeps listening with the screen off, and that cost was not measured.
- **Other phones and builds:** only one SM-A236B on the `20260316` build.
- **Turning the setting off:** the module sends `aot_enable,0`, but that path was never run.
- **Calls:** the proximity sensor can turn the screen off during a call without a sleep request. There was no SIM in the phone.
- **Long-term use:** the hand test was short.
- **The `lxs_ts.ko` fix from [post #80](https://xdaforums.com/t/rom-15-0-unofficial-dicontinued-sm-a236b-lineageos-22-2-for-samsung-galaxy-a23-5g-ss-ds.4760330/page-4):** it restarts touch on wake with a patched driver. This module was never tested alongside it.

## OVT panels

haky86's logs in [post #83](https://xdaforums.com/t/rom-15-0-unofficial-dicontinued-sm-a236b-lineageos-22-2-for-samsung-galaxy-a23-5g-ss-ds.4760330/page-5) come from a different controller:

```
ovt_tcm_spi spi0.1: [sec_input] Incorrect header marker (0x00)
ovt_tcm_spi spi0.1: [sec_input] Failed to read message
```

Those are also zeros read from the chip, as seen here when the panel is already off. That makes the same cause worth testing, **but it is only a lead.** I have no OVT phone, and did not check how that driver is told about screen changes.

## Why a script and not a kernel patch?

A script needs no kernel build and comes off with the module. The cleaner fix belongs in the driver or the device tree, so that the screen state reaches `lxs_ts` directly. `lxs_notifier_call` in `lxs_ts_dev.c` currently handles only ESD recovery. I did not check whether that notifier fires early enough.

## Links

**The ROM**
- [XDA thread: LineageOS 22.2 for the Galaxy A23 5G](https://xdaforums.com/t/rom-15-0-unofficial-dicontinued-sm-a236b-lineageos-22-2-for-samsung-galaxy-a23-5g-ss-ds.4760330/), by haky86
- [`lineage-22.2-20260316-UNOFFICIAL-a23xq.zip`](https://www.mediafire.com/file/zxneye5wha6zwi9/lineage-22.2-20260316-UNOFFICIAL-a23xq.zip/file) and [its recovery](https://www.mediafire.com/file/ecu0gk5xv9ja94b/recovery-22.2-20260316-UNOFFICIAL-a23xq.tar/file)
- [`lxs_ts` driver source at the running kernel commit](https://github.com/Haky86/android_kernel_samsung_sm6375_old/tree/920d1d7c7904/drivers/input/touchscreen/lxsemicon/lx891rs)

**Double tap and touch discussion in that thread**
- [Posts #42 to #49](https://xdaforums.com/t/rom-15-0-unofficial-dicontinued-sm-a236b-lineageos-22-2-for-samsung-galaxy-a23-5g-ss-ds.4760330/page-3): touch stops working after the screen locks
- [Post #80](https://xdaforums.com/t/rom-15-0-unofficial-dicontinued-sm-a236b-lineageos-22-2-for-samsung-galaxy-a23-5g-ss-ds.4760330/page-4): the `lxs_ts.ko` fix
- [Posts #81 to #83](https://xdaforums.com/t/rom-15-0-unofficial-dicontinued-sm-a236b-lineageos-22-2-for-samsung-galaxy-a23-5g-ss-ds.4760330/page-5): double tap on OVT

**Related**
- [a23xq-hotspot-fix](https://github.com/Anezium/a23xq-hotspot-fix): hotspot fixes for the same ROM
- [Magisk v31.1](https://github.com/topjohnwu/Magisk/releases/tag/v31.1)
